title: Lunar Dreamweaver
description: A surreal painting of a large anthropomorphic moon with a feminine face and wide eyes, positioned centrally. Colorful swirling nebulae in pink, purple, and blue emanate from its mouth and cheek, while two birds perch on bare white branches on either side against a starry cosmic background with floating spheres.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a large grey moon with a detailed feminine human face and wide expressive eyes at the center. Vibrant swirling nebulae in magenta, purple, and blue flow from its mouth and cheek area. Two birds, one black crow and one grey dove, perch on bare white tree branches on the left and right sides. Floating colorful spheres and feathers drift in the cosmic space around the moon, with a soft green and pink gradient background filled with small stars.
